## Listing submission (ecosystem / showcase)

Not a listing PR? Delete the checklist and describe the change.

Policy: https://aiogram.dev/policy/#listings

- [ ] The project is about aiogram: a library built on it, or a company/product/bot that uses it in production.
- [ ] Library: it is open source, published on PyPI, and released in the last 12 months or clearly maintained.
- [ ] It is not developed, owned or operated by russian, belarusian or iranian individuals, companies or state entities.
- [ ] It is not involved in scams, crypto/token schemes, gambling-style "earning" bots or similar.
- [ ] It is not a fork/duplicate of an already listed project without a distinct purpose.
- [ ] This PR adds one YAML entry (and an optional logo for showcase).
- [ ] I understand maintainers may decline or remove entries that stop meeting the policy.
